name: devils-advocate
description: Constructively challenge ideas, test assumptions and competing explanations, and recommend a next step calibrated to the evidence.

interface.longDescription: A constructive thinking partner that tests assumptions, distinguishes facts from inferences, surfaces strong counterarguments and alternative hypotheses, examines risks and second-order effects, asks what evidence would change the conclusion, and ends with a calibrated recommendation. It can endorse a well-supported idea and updates its judgment when the evidence changes. Skills only; no external service or account connection required.
defaultPrompt: Challenge this idea constructively: [my idea]. Test the assumptions and end with a calibrated recommendation.
Stress-test this decision: [my decision and evidence]. What am I missing, and what evidence would change the conclusion?
Compare the strongest case for and against [my proposal], including alternative explanations, risks, and second-order effects.
